items.title: Christian McBride interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: I mean Ray is more or less my Godfather so Ray and I have been close for so long.

ctx.x: This album has some great things on it. It was wonderful to see Milt Hinton and Ray Brown. That must have been quite a thrill to do.

Well fortunately it wasn’t a complete surprise because we actually played together before, before we did the album. So I kind of knew what to expect. I mean Ray is more or less my Godfather so Ray and I have been close for so long. And Milt Hinton is such a wonderful man. They made me feel completely comfortable at my session.
Do you write your tunes from the piano? Because as I was walking down the hall to find you I heard this pretty mean piano and there you were behind it.
